Hollis, the ticket is PD-4821. You posted about it in #central-team on June 9.

The mismatch is in the door labels. The import file calls the Eastbank doors E1 and E2. Marrow Agrisupply's booking sheet calls them 01 and 02. You wanted that sorted before anyone reimported, so it wouldn't create duplicate doors.

I haven't seen any later update on whether it was resolved, so check the ticket before the call.
